recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-19289 unless FM later decides to retire or rename the separate pharmacy service example.
issue_request: FHIR-19289 was Published with a Persuasive resolution and asked to change the Claim examples list so the Simple Pharmacy Service Claim entry for the professional example was changed from Pharmacy to Professional.
initial_application: The 2018Sep rendered Claim examples page showed claim-example-professional with the duplicate text "Simple Pharmacy Service Claim" while claim-example-pharmacy also used that text. No explicit FHIR-19289 implementation commit was found; the 2021 source rework introduced current list-Claim-examples.xml with claim-example-professional already labeled "Simple Professional Service Claim".
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source has distinct professional and pharmacy examples with matching Claim.type codes, and the current rendered build shows the two labels distinctly. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the requested examples-list correction. No source hunk was needed, and changing the separate pharmacy service example would be overbroad.
